svg.text: 1. Board into the FRONT bay, camera pointing DOWN through the window — the bay rails and stop locate it; USB-C ends up facing up.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Battery flat in the REAR bay, lying across the pod (its 30 mm side spans the width, its 20 mm side runs along the length).

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. Both wires through the divider's centre gap — nothing pinched under the board, nothing lying over the window.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. One zip tie over each bay, threaded through the side-wall notches; snug, not crushing. Trim the tails flush so the pod still slides in.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 5. Fold the camera ribbon flat beside the board — never across the window, and never pinched under a zip tie.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6. Snap on the U.FL antenna (in the XIAO's box — it is required) and tape it OUTSIDE a side wall. Never on top of the battery: foil detunes it.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Dry-fit the 160° module first — its barrel is taller than the stock camera. The window is a 12 mm hole through 2.4 mm of floor, so the barrel

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: nests into it and buys back that height. Keep the opening otherwise clear: no tape, no glue, no wire, no ribbon across it.
